# Sleep.ai

> Sleep.ai delivers science-backed sleep tracking, measurement, and improvement solutions through APIs, wearable-free technology, and personalized coaching platforms.

Sleep.ai combines sonar-based sleep tracking with clinical validation and digital health services. The company offers both consumer-facing applications (SleepScore, Dein Schlaf) and enterprise solutions (Sleep API, Sleep Sense) for sleep measurement and engagement.

## Key Topics

- Sleep Tracking
- Sleep Measurement
- Wearable-Free Technology
- Sonar-Based Detection
- Sleep API
- Sleep Sense
- SleepScore
- Personalized Coaching
- Sleep Science
- Clinical Validation
- Digital Health
- Sleep Improvement
- Circadian Rhythm
- Sleep Analysis
- R&D Services

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Sleep API](https://www.sleep.ai/sleep-api): Sleep API: engagement, retention, and lifetime value platform.
- [Sleep Sense](https://www.sleep.ai/sleep-sense): Sleep Sense: frictionless wearable-free sleep measurement at scale.
- [SleepScore App](https://www.sleep.ai/sleepscore): SleepScore: sonar-based sleep tracking and science-based coaching.
- [Dein Schlaf](https://www.sleep.ai/dein-schlaf): Dein Schlaf: personalized sleep coaching and improvement program.
